comment: Hand-drawn schematic by Fred Briggs, 2012. No designators except Q1/Q2; parts numbered here.
uncertain: The three panel pots are numbered 1-3 on the drawing but not named; pot 3 (10KA) is the output level, pot 2 (100KB) sits between Q1 and Q2 as in the Rangepig, and pot 1 (100K) with a 2.2u cap bypasses the 4.7n input cap.
The polarity diode's type is not given.
rows: emitter trimmer; set Q2 collector to -6.6V
